title: Godot crashing when reimporting 3D models in a scene with an imported animation
body:
### Tested versions

v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 27.20.100.8439) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (6 Threads)

### Issue description

2. Open the "Animation" tab
3. Reimport the model
